# TextMate grammar fixtures

`vscode-markdown.tmLanguage.json` is the generated Markdown grammar bundled with
VS Code 1.132.0 (`markdown-basics` 30.0.0), pinned from
[`microsoft/vscode-markdown-tm-grammar`](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-markdown-tm-grammar/tree/0812fc4b190efc17bfed0d5b4ff918eff8e4e377).
It is used only to test this extension's injection precedence against the real
host grammar.
